title: Turn technical documentation into actions
summary: Read an English runbook and extract executable steps without translation.
learningObjectives: Identify prerequisites, commands, success signals and recovery steps directly in English.

sections.title: Your mission
sections.body: A teammate asks you to perform a safe cache migration using only the English runbook.

sections.title: Cache migration runbook
sections.content: Synthetic training artifact — non-production. Before running the migration, confirm that the queue depth is below 100, create a configuration snapshot and enable read-only mode. Run cachectl migrate --target v2. A successful migration prints MIGRATION_COMPLETE and the new cache reports healthy within two minutes. If health remains degraded, run cachectl rollback --snapshot latest, verify that the restored cache reports healthy, then disable read-only mode and notify the on-call engineer. Do not retry migration until the incident owner approves it.

expressions.phrase: Before running ___, confirm ___, save ___ and enable ___.
expressions.meaning: Gom mọi prerequisite cần hoàn tất trước command.
expressions.example: Before running the migration, confirm queue depth, save a snapshot and enable read-only mode.

expressions.meaning: Nêu đầy đủ các tín hiệu thành công cùng time limit.
expressions.example: Success requires MIGRATION_COMPLETE and healthy status within two minutes.

expressions.phrase: If ___ remains degraded, roll back ___; verify ___ before disabling ___.
expressions.meaning: Giữ đúng thứ tự recovery trước khi mở lại write traffic.
expressions.example: If health remains degraded, roll back the snapshot; verify the restored cache is healthy before disabling read-only mode.
alternatives: On failure, restore ___ and confirm ___ before ___.

exercises.question: What must happen before the migration command?
options: Confirm queue depth below 100, create a snapshot and enable read-only mode.
Create a snapshot, run the migration and enable read-only mode afterward to protect the cache.
Notify the incident owner and retry until the cache is healthy.
correctAnswer: Confirm queue depth below 100, create a snapshot and enable read-only mode.
exercises.explanation: All three prerequisites must be complete before cachectl migrate runs.

exercises.question: Which evidence proves that the migration succeeded?
options: MIGRATION_COMPLETE plus healthy cache status within two minutes.
The command starts without errors and queue depth remains below 100 during the run.
Read-only mode is enabled and the on-call engineer is notified.
correctAnswer: MIGRATION_COMPLETE plus healthy cache status within two minutes.
exercises.explanation: The runbook requires both the completion message and healthy status inside the stated time window.

exercises.question: Put the degraded-health recovery steps in the documented safe order.
options: Notify the on-call engineer and wait for approval before retrying.
Verify that the restored cache reports healthy.
correctAnswer: Verify that the restored cache reports healthy.
Notify the on-call engineer and wait for approval before retrying.
exercises.explanation: Health is verified after rollback and before read-only mode is disabled; notification and approval protect any later retry.

performanceTask.title: Produce an execution checklist
performanceTask.scenario: You must hand a safe four-step checklist to the engineer running the migration.
performanceTask.baselinePrompt: Language-only cold attempt: read once and write the actions from memory without translating; treat the result as an unverified draft, not an execution checklist.
performanceTask.performancePrompt: Using the displayed runbook, write four bullets in English covering all three prerequisites, command, success signal and rollback/escalation. Verify every step against the source before submitting.
performanceTask.modelResponse: • Confirm queue depth is below 100, save a configuration snapshot and enable read-only mode. • Run cachectl migrate --target v2. • Verify MIGRATION_COMPLETE and healthy status within two minutes. • If degraded, rollback the latest snapshot; verify the restored cache is healthy; only then disable read-only mode, notify on-call and wait for approval before retrying.
performanceTask.retryPrompt: Return to the source, correct one omitted safety condition, then rewrite without copying full sentences.
performanceTask.transferPrompt: Read the displayed database upgrade runbook and write a new four-part checklist in English. Extract every condition from that source without reusing cache-specific details.
performanceTask.reviewPrompt: Read a new short runbook and extract prerequisite, action, success signal and recovery without translation.

retry.title: Cache migration evidence
retry.brief: Use the same source only to repair the safety condition you omitted; then close it and rewrite.

artifacts.title: Safety-critical details
artifacts.content: Synthetic training artifact — non-production. Prerequisites: queue depth below 100, a configuration snapshot and read-only mode enabled. Success: MIGRATION_COMPLETE plus healthy status within two minutes. Recovery: rollback latest, verify that the restored cache is healthy, then disable read-only mode, notify on-call and wait for incident-owner approval before retrying.

transfer.title: Database schema upgrade
transfer.brief: Unseen runbook: extract the same four functions without copying the cache example.

artifacts.title: Schema upgrade procedure
artifacts.content: Synthetic training artifact — non-production. Confirm replica lag is below five seconds, back up the schema and disable writes. Run dbctl upgrade --target 14. Success is reported as SCHEMA_OK after validation. If validation fails, restore the backup, verify that the previous schema reports healthy and page the database owner. Keep writes disabled until the database owner approves re-enabling them.

review.title: Certificate rotation
review.brief: Delayed review: recover prerequisite, action, success signal and recovery from a new procedure.

artifacts.title: Certificate rotation procedure
artifacts.content: Synthetic training artifact — non-production. Verify the replacement certificate has at least 90 days remaining and save the current thumbprint. Run certctl rotate --service api. Confirm TLS_CHECK_OK from every region. If any region fails, restore the previous thumbprint and alert security operations.

trainingSource.title: Feature flag rollout procedure
trainingSource.content: Synthetic training artifact — non-production. Confirm the error budget is green and save the current flag allocation. Run flagctl set checkout-v2 --percent 10. Success requires error_rate below 1% for fifteen minutes. If the threshold is exceeded, restore the saved allocation and notify the release owner.

extractionItems.question: What must be true before rollout?
options: The flag is already at 100% for all users
extractionItems.feedback: The prerequisite appears before the command.

extractionItems.question: What proves success?
options: The command exits immediately without printing any errors
Error rate falls below 10% in the first minute
Error rate stays below 1% for fifteen minutes
extractionItems.correctAnswer: Error rate stays below 1% for fifteen minutes
extractionItems.feedback: A command exit is not the operational success signal.

extractionItems.question: What is the recovery action?
options: Increase traffic to 50% and retry the rollout
Confirm the error budget is green and save the current flag allocation
Restore the saved allocation and notify the release owner
extractionItems.correctAnswer: Restore the saved allocation and notify the release owner

readingLadder.applicationPrompt: Explain the displayed feature-flag rollout as prerequisite → action → success signal → recovery.

rubric.label: Safety conditions
